units.source_text: 到了岁暮，源氏命令为玉鬘居室准备新年装饰，为众仆从添制新年服装，与其他诸高贵夫人一例同等。

en.t: At the end of the year, Genji ordered New Year decorations to be prepared for Tamakazura's rooms, and new holiday clothes to be made for all her attendants, treating her in exactly the same way as the other noble ladies.

units.source_text: 玉鬘容貌虽然美丽，但源氏推量她总还有些乡村风习，所以也送她些乡村式衣服。

en.t: Although Tamakazura was beautiful, Genji supposed that she still retained some rustic habits, and so he also sent her some country-style garments.

units.source_text: 织工们竭尽技能，织成种种绫罗。

en.t: The weavers exhausted all their skill, producing many kinds of figured silk and gauze.

units.source_text: 源氏看到这些绫罗所制成的各种女衫、礼服，琳琅满目，对紫姬说道：“花样多得很呢！

en.t: When Genji saw the splendid array of women's robes and ceremonial garments made from these silks, he said to Lady Murasaki, "There are so many patterns!

units.source_text: 分配给各人时，要使大家不相妒羡才好。”

en.t: When we distribute them, we must make sure no one becomes jealous of another."

units.source_text: 紫姬便将裁缝所制作的和自己家里制作的全部取出来。

en.t: Lady Murasaki then brought out everything made by the seamstresses and everything made in her own household.

units.source_text: 紫姬十分擅长此道，故色彩配合甚美，染色亦极精良。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was highly skilled in such matters, so the color combinations were beautiful and the dyeing was extremely fine.

units.source_text: 源氏对她十分赞佩。

en.t: Genji admired her greatly.

units.source_text: 他看了各处捣场送来的有光泽的衣服，便选出深紫色的和大红色的，教人装在衣柜及衣箱中，吩咐在旁伺候的几个年长的上等侍女，令她们分别送与各人。

en.t: After examining the lustrous garments sent from the various fulling places, he chose deep purple and bright crimson ones, had them placed in wardrobes and chests, and ordered several older senior gentlewomen in attendance to deliver them to the proper recipients.

units.source_text: 紫姬看见了，说道：“分配得固然很平均，没有优劣之差了。

en.t: Lady Murasaki saw this and said, "The distribution is certainly even, with no difference in rank or quality.

units.source_text: 然而送人衣服，要顾到衣服的色彩与穿的人的容貌相调和。

en.t: But when giving clothes to someone, one must consider whether the colors harmonize with the appearance of the person who will wear them.

units.source_text: 如果色彩与穿的人的模样不相称，就很难看。”

en.t: If the colors do not suit the wearer's looks, the effect is very unattractive."

units.source_text: 源氏笑道：“你一声不响地看我选，却在心中推量人的容貌。

en.t: Genji laughed and said, "You watch me choose in silence, yet in your heart you are judging everyone's looks.

units.source_text: 那么你宜乎穿什么颜色的衣服呢？”

en.t: Then what color clothes would suit you?"

units.source_text: 紫姬答道：“叫我自己对镜子看，怎么看得出呢？”

en.t: Lady Murasaki replied, "How could I tell by looking at myself in a mirror?"

units.source_text: 意思是要源氏看，说过之后觉得很难为情。

en.t: She meant that she wanted Genji to look for her, and after saying it she felt deeply embarrassed.

units.source_text: 结果如此分配：送紫姬的是红梅色浮织纹样上衣和淡紫色礼服，以及最优美的流行色彩的衬袍；

en.t: In the end the gifts were assigned as follows: for Lady Murasaki, an upper robe with raised woven patterns in red-plum color, a pale purple ceremonial robe, and an under-robe in the most beautiful fashionable colors;

units.source_text: 送明石小女公子的是白面红里的常礼服，再添一件表里皆鲜红色的衫子；

en.t: for the young Akashi princess, an ordinary ceremonial robe white on the outside and red within, with an additional robe bright crimson both inside and out;

units.source_text: 送花散里的是海景纹样的淡宝蓝外衣——织工极好，但不甚惹目，——和表里皆深红色的女衫；

en.t: for Hanachirusato, a pale sapphire-blue outer robe with a seascape pattern, exquisitely woven but not very conspicuous, and a woman's robe deep red both inside and out;

units.source_text: 送玉鬘的是鲜红色外衣和棣棠色常礼服。

en.t: for Tamakazura, a bright crimson outer robe and an ordinary ceremonial robe in kerria-yellow.

units.source_text: 紫姬装作不见，但在心里想象玉鬘的容貌。

en.t: Lady Murasaki pretended not to notice, but in her heart she imagined Tamakazura's appearance.

units.source_text: 她似乎在推量：“内大臣相貌艳丽而清秀，但缺乏优雅之趣。

en.t: She seemed to be thinking, "The Minister of the Palace is striking and handsome, but he lacks a certain elegant charm.

units.source_text: 玉鬘大概与他相像。”

en.t: Tamakazura probably resembles him."

units.source_text: 虽然不动声色，但因源氏心虚，似觉她的脸色有异。

en.t: Although she gave no outward sign, Genji felt guilty and thought her expression seemed somehow changed.

units.source_text: 他说道：“我看，按照容貌分配，恐怕她们会生气呢。

en.t: He said, "It seems to me that if I assigned them according to looks, they might be offended.

units.source_text: 色彩无论何等美好，终有限度；人的容貌即使不美，也许其人另有好处。”

en.t: No matter how beautiful a color is, there are limits to it; and even if a person's appearance is not beautiful, she may have other merits."

units.source_text: 说过之后，便选择送末摘花的衣服：白面绿里的外衣，上面织着散乱而雅致的藤蔓花纹，非常优美。

en.t: After saying this, he chose the clothes for Suetsumuhana: an outer robe white on the outside and green within, woven with scattered yet graceful wisteria-vine patterns, very beautiful indeed.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得这衣服与这人很不相称，在心中微笑。

en.t: Genji felt that these clothes were quite unsuited to her, and smiled inwardly.

units.source_text: 送明石姬的是有梅花折枝及飞舞鸟蝶纹样的白色中国式礼服，和鲜艳的浓紫色衬袍。

en.t: For Lady Akashi, he chose a white Chinese-style ceremonial robe patterned with broken plum branches and fluttering birds and butterflies, together with a vivid deep-purple under-robe.

units.source_text: 紫姬由此推想明石姬气度高傲，脸上显出不快之色。

en.t: From this, Lady Murasaki imagined that Lady Akashi had a proud bearing, and displeasure showed on her face.

units.source_text: 送尼姑空蝉的是青灰色外衣，非常优雅，再从源氏自己的衣服中选出一件栀子花色衫子，又加一件淡红色女衫。

en.t: For Utsusemi, now a nun, he chose a blue-gray outer robe of great elegance, then selected a gardenia-colored robe from his own garments and added a pale red woman's robe as well.

units.source_text: 每人的衣服内附一信，叫她们大家在元旦穿。

en.t: A letter was placed with each person's clothes, instructing them all to wear the garments on New Year's Day.

units.source_text: 他想在那天看看，色彩是否适合各人的容貌。

en.t: He wanted to see on that day whether the colors suited each woman's appearance.
